rooftops.title: Rooftop Gardens
rooftops.brief: rooftop garden walkways above a sci-fi market district: raised planter beds with vegetables and glowing flora, patched solar sails on poles, humming AC units and vent stacks, metal catwalks with railings between roof sections, cables, a distant skyline of stacked city blocks under a hazy sky

observatory.title: Skyward Observatory
observatory.brief: a clifftop observatory terrace: a dome building with its slit open and a brass-and-steel telescope aimed at the sky, star-chart boards on stands, low stone-and-metal terraces with steps, railings at the cliff edge, small service shed, cold night-leaning light with warm lamps

night-bazaar.title: Night Bazaar
night-bazaar.brief: a dense covered market alley: market stalls with patched fabric awnings, strings of hanging lanterns, a noodle counter with steam, stacked crates of produce and parts, neon signs in an invented script, puddles reflecting the lights, narrow walking lanes between the stalls

gate-wall.title: The City Gate
gate-wall.brief: the great city wall seen from inside: a massive armored gate with warning stripes and rivets, guard kiosks with screens, sandbag positions, spotlights on masts, a wide cracked-concrete apron in front of the gate, faded road markings, hazard signage

outskirts.title: Outskirts Scrub
outskirts.brief: scrubland outside the city wall: broken slabs of an ancient highway half-buried in dust, rusted transmission pylons, a crashed cargo hauler overgrown with hardy teal plants, scattered boulders, a worn footpath, the city wall looming along one edge

residential.title: Residential Stacks
residential.brief: a courtyard between stacked modular homes: prefab housing units stacked two and three high with external metal stairs, laundry lines with clothes between units, mailbox clusters, potted plants on landings, a small shared courtyard with benches and a water spigot

canal-docks.title: Canal Docks
canal-docks.brief: a waterfront dock on a teal canal: a moored rusty barge, a small cargo crane, bollards with coiled ropes, stacked shipping crates, a fish stall with hanging catch, wooden-and-metal boardwalk planks along the waterline, gulls-eye clutter of nets and floats

hydroponics.title: Hydroponics Hall
hydroponics.brief: the interior of a hydroponics grow-hall: long parallel rows of glass grow-tanks with young trees and crops glowing softly, overhead irrigation pipes with drip lines, control consoles with green screens, a central walking aisle and side aisles between tank rows, wet reflective floor

repair-bay.title: Repair Bay
repair-bay.brief: the interior of a repair workshop: a vehicle hoist holding a half-dismantled rover with its guts exposed, tool walls with outlined tools, a welding corner with scorch marks, parts shelves, rolling toolboxes, oil stains on the concrete floor, task lamps

transit.title: Maglev Platform
transit.brief: a maglev transit platform: a recessed rail channel with glowing guide strips, waiting benches, ticket gates, route-map screens on pylons, a platform-edge warning line, vending machine, departure board, roof canopy with hanging signage

underworks.title: The Underworks
underworks.brief: underground maintenance tunnels: thick pipes running along the walls with valve wheels, a grated metal floor over a glowing teal coolant channel, service lamps in wire cages, junction boxes, stenciled numbers on the walls, dripping condensation, a wide main tunnel with side alcoves

power-plant.title: Reactor Hall
power-plant.brief: a reactor hall: a giant glowing energy pylon (a big sibling of a small plaza pylon) inside a containment ring, heavy braided cables snaking to floor sockets, a raised control pulpit with levers and dials, warning chevrons painted on the floor, coolant tanks along the walls

plaza-market-inside.title: Plaza Market — Inside
plaza-market-inside.brief: the interior of a small covered market shop: shelves of canned and dried goods with handwritten price tags, a counter with an old register terminal, hanging dried herbs and cables, a cooler cabinet with a soft glow, crates in the corners, a worn rug on the metal floor, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

noodle-bar.title: Noodle Bar
noodle-bar.brief: the tiny interior of a noodle bar: a counter with stools, steaming pots on a burner bank behind it, stacked bowls, a menu board with an invented script, a small shrine with a bobbing cat figure, string lights, condensation on a small window, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

home-interior-a.title: Stack Home — Ground Unit
home-interior-a.brief: a cozy one-room prefab home interior: a bed with a patched quilt, a small kitchen nook with a kettle, a workbench with tools and a half-repaired drone, potted plants on a shelf, family photos on the wall, a floor heater with a soft glow, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

guard-post.title: Gate Guard Post
guard-post.brief: the interior of a small guard kiosk: a wall of monitors showing gate camera feeds, a control desk with levers and a mug, a locker with a hanging coat, a cot in the corner, a bulletin board with notices, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

observatory-dome.title: Observatory Dome
observatory-dome.brief: the interior of an observatory dome: the great brass-and-steel telescope on its mount dominating the center, a curved control console with dials and a star map screen, bookshelves with charts, a rolling ladder, the dome slit open showing a strip of sky, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

barge-cabin.title: Barge Cabin
barge-cabin.brief: the cramped cabin interior of a canal barge: a wheel and throttle levers at a small helm window, rope coils and nets, a bunk with a wool blanket, a tiny stove with a kettle, lanterns swinging from the ceiling beams, crates of catch, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

grow-lab-office.title: Grow-Lab Office
grow-lab-office.brief: a small control office overlooking a hydroponics hall: desks with terminals showing plant growth charts, seed sample drawers, wall-mounted gauges and valves, a microscope bench, clipboards, a coffee machine, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

transit-office.title: Transit Ticket Office
transit-office.brief: the interior of a transit ticket office: a service counter with a slotted window, a route map covering one wall with glowing lines, stamp machines, stacked schedule pamphlets, a sleeping fan heater, lost-and-found shelf with odd items, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

pump-station.title: Pump Station
pump-station.brief: a small underground pump room: a big rotary pump with exposed gears and a pressure wheel, pipes running into the floor and ceiling, gauge clusters, a tool rack, a drain grate in the floor with a soft teal glow from below, warning signs, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

control-room.title: Reactor Control Room
control-room.brief: the reactor control pulpit interior: a wraparound console with switch banks, sliders and blinking indicator walls, a big central status screen showing the reactor column, two operator chairs, coffee cups and manuals, a red emergency handle under glass, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

repair-office.title: Repair Bay Office
repair-office.brief: a cluttered mechanic's office: a desk buried in part diagrams and invoices, shelf walls of labeled component bins, a pegboard with specialty tools, a half-disassembled robot head on the desk with one eye lit, a service lift schedule board, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame

salvage-shed.title: Outskirts Salvage Shed
salvage-shed.brief: the interior of a scrap-built shed: walls of corrugated panels, shelves of salvaged parts sorted in cans, a generator with a pull cord, a hammock, a heat lamp, tools hanging from wire hooks, a small window showing dusty scrubland, a doorway opening at the bottom edge of the frame
